name: ScrollCoverflow
description: A pinned 3D coverflow carousel inside its own smooth-scroll viewport: scrolling glides the cards past the center, where the active card faces forward while its neighbours rotate away and recede in depth.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" labelled by the title, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrow/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the top/bottom edge wheel events are released to the page, and touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Cards are a list with real text; the active card gets aria-current and its title is announced through a polite live caption. Progress dots are labelled buttons that scroll to each card. Decorative SVG art is aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted and cards slide flat without 3D rotation or depth.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.default: ['Midnight Drive', 'Neon Bloom', 'Low Tide', 'Paper Moons', 'Afterglow', 'Static Hearts', 'Golden Hour']
propsApi.description: Card titles, one gradient card per item.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Heading above the carousel; also used as the scroll region's aria-label.

propsApi.name: angle
propsApi.description: Rotation in degrees applied to cards beside the center card.

propsApi.name: spacing
propsApi.description: Horizontal distance in px between neighbouring cards.

propsApi.name: depth
propsApi.description: How far in px side cards are pushed back along the Z axis.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for the kicker, floor glow and active progress dot.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
